newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-No cricket team until fitness checked.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-No cricket team until fitness checked.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Sept 16 - New Zealand's cricket selectors want to check the fitness of several players this week before naming 15 players to tour Sharjah and Pakistan in November and December, NZPA reports.
Convener Ross Dykes said yesterday fast bowler Danny Morrison was to have a fitness test on Wednesday, and Chris Harris and Chris Cairns were due home this week from England.

Dykes said although opening batsman Blair Pocock's injured knee was better, he was behind in his general fitness and cricket skills training, and Dion Nash was continuing his rehabilitation after a back injury.
"We can't name a team until we check these guys out," Dykes said.
"We'll be aiming to give New Zealand Cricket the names of the 15 players next weekend."

Morrison needs to satisfy the selectors of his fitness after an operation following the West Indies tour, and although fellow opening bowler Nash is progressing, the pre-Christmas tour will probably be too early for him.
Dykes said Simon Doull was fit to leave on Wednesday for the Hong Kong sixes.
